correctness.rationale: Exact generating product is a normalized pgf of independent 3-valued increments; centered covariance is diag(log n)+O(1), and the sum of third cumulant remainders is O(log n). A whole-torus inequality |phi_n|<=exp[-2s_n(theta^2+phi^2)/pi^2] with s_n~log n supplies an integrable Gaussian majorant on rescaling; L1 Fourier convergence proves the uniform lattice local limit. Gaussian peak comparisons prove exact leading constant and every-maximizer scale. Independent brute force n<=8 and source sequence n<=24 check normalization.

originality.rationale: Original contribution is the uniform bivariate lattice local limit and sharp asymptotic A_n~n!/(2 pi log n) for a named, archived arithmetic/combinatorial sequence. Khovanova–Lewis had exact counts and balancing; Gnedin had the equivalent record array and a weak Gaussian CLT but did not state a lattice local limit or sharp peak. OEIS gives finite values, not this asymptotic. No explicit direct prior was found in actual targeted searches; generic local-limit coverage is recorded as a methodological priority risk.
residual_risks: A general multivariate triangular-array lattice local limit theorem may subsume the local approximation after verifying its assumptions; novelty rests on the explicit sharp sequence maximum, not generality of the method.
The relevant original Gnedin array predates Khovanova–Lewis under an exactly equivalent record interpretation.
Unindexed published or unpublished work may already derive the precise sequence maximum.
Only the abstract, not full text, of the 2024 separable-permutation paper was inspected; its stated domain is different.
